name: spaCy NLP
summary: Named-entity recognition (NER) plus a rule matcher over a text.
description: Strips named entities out of text with the en_core_web_sm model, then runs a small set of pattern rules over the token stream (organisation + hiring, location + open-role, money + costs, date + project). Blocks the flow of recurring patterns so the board can react to them. Deterministic and local — no network, no secrets, no authentication.

capabilities.description: Strips named entities out of text
Runs pattern rules over the token stream

example.text: Apple Inc. is headquartered in Cupertino, California.
